Fetch your GitHub activity (PRs, commits, reviews) through the gh CLI

## Usage

    gournal sync [options]

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `--since <date>` | Start date (local day or ISO timestamp). Default: the last sync. |  |
